Maya (CS): Hey @product @eng — quick capture from the Acme Retail onboarding call (just finished). Short list of asks + pain points so we can prioritize before renewal.
Ethan (PM): thanks Maya — can you paste the raw notes + any customer quotes? Renewal is ~6 weeks out so priority context is helpful.
Maya (CS): pasted below. TL;DR: they need per-route cost visibility, embeddings TTL control per project, and easier model-variant toggles for canaries.
Maya (CS): 1) Per-route cost breakdown in Console — finance + AE want CSV export. Quote: "we can't attribute spend across teams if it's one big bucket."
Maya (CS): 2) Embeddings TTL per-route — they're seeing duplicate vectors and storage bloat. Ask: ability to set retention/TTL per project or route.
Maya (CS): 3) Model-variant switch UX — they want quick canary toggles with rollback and a visible impact forecast (latency/cost).
Jules (Eng): per-route cost is mostly telemetry + UI work. We need a small schema change in event tagging and a CSV endpoint. Roughly 2 devs x 2 sprints if prioritized.
Priya (Product Ops): embedding TTL seems higher-impact on unit costs. Any data on how much storage they saw?
Maya (CS): Acme said their embeddings grew 4x over 3 months after a data migration mistake. They're nervous about recurring cost.
DataOps Bot: scheduled retention-scan job created for Acme tenant (job id: 7890).
Jules (Eng): for TTL we can add per-route retention as a config + background compaction job. Need Product to confirm acceptable default + delete policy.
Ethan (PM): I'll create a backlog item and tag onboarding-critical + renewal-risk. Priya — can you run a quick ROI sketch for TTL vs 1-yr retention?
Priya (Product Ops): on it. Also flagging enablement: AE team needs a one-pager explaining per-route billing and steps to export costs.
Maya (CS): noted — I'll draft the AE runbook and collect one more direct customer quote to attach.
Ethan (PM): great. Jules, can you spare an engineer for a short spike to propose telemetry changes? 1 week spike ok?
Jules (Eng): yes — we'll do a spike next week and post results here.
Maya (CS): quote to add to ticket: "If we don't get per-route views, we can't justify the usage for multiple teams".
Priya (Product Ops): thanks — I'll consolidate notes and drop a short decision doc. :thumbsup:
